purpose: Track changing prices of a virtual basket with equal initial capital per product on admission and fixed subsequent quantities; neutral entries and verified exits.

selectionRationale.weighting: Whole-product initial capital equality was selected after the one-copy policy produced 98.35% Pokemon PSA10 value exposure in the preliminary source audit. The change addresses high-price/condition concentration, not the size or shape of the index. Actual prices and fixed subsequent quantities still determine subsequent value weights.
selectionRationale.membership: All eligible products, not top 30 or today's winners. The cutoff is yesterday; missing prices alone never remove an admitted product.
selectionRationale.review: Monthly admissions with fixed existing quantities, no repeated equal-return chaining or automatic condition replacement.
selectionRationale.baseline: Explicit operating baseline; older single-product source dates are not presented as a full-platform history.
selectionRationale.missingPriceModel: Actual same-condition native quote date must anchor the missing-price estimate. Rolling-window-end anchors fail the exact common-trend calendar invariant and are benchmark-only. Choose the native grouping by disjoint development price-blackout error, never curve magnitude; freeze and run final held-out prices separately.

predictionDevelopmentReview.hardConstraint: actual native quote date alignment; rolling-window-end anchors are benchmark-only
